TRUMP: U.S. TO BECOME “GUARDIAN OF THE HORMUZ STRAIT”

President Trump said the U.S. would reinstate its blockade of Iranian ships and seek a 20% reimbursement on other cargo transiting the Strait of Hormuz.

The plan would begin immediately, though key details remain unclear.
